reply_text:
I've replied to Pree in her DM: her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is **21 October**. She set that in her 14 October message and hasn't changed it in the DM since.

I couldn't read back the note I saved for her in gbrain. gbrain refused because this bot's connection isn't tied to any one member, so it read nothing. The answer comes from the DM itself instead, which Pree can see.

Saved notes like this one can't be read back until someone fixes this on the machine that hosts gbrain. They would run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>` to tie the connection to one member. For a shared bot like this one, gbrain also offers listing the members it may act for and naming the member on each call. I haven't changed anything there.
